results.title: Building And Factory - MyBMC - Welcome to BMC's Website
excerpts:
The **Building & Factories Department** is an Administrative Department of BMC that issues various Permits in consultation with and advice from other technical advisory departments like, Fire Brigade, Engineering, Estate, etc.
In view of this it is necessary for any Establishment/Individual/Societies to obtain required Permit from Building & Factories department before starting any activities including permissions for Factory Permit/ Flour Mill Permit, Balcony Enclosure, Loft Permission, WCC Permission, Repair Permission and Temporary Monsoon Shed/ Mandap permission

results.title: HC orders BMC to urgently consider granting permissions for temporary film sets | Mumbai news - Hindustan Times
excerpts:
# HC orders BMC to urgently consider granting permissions for temporary film sets
## The BMC had suspended its 2019 policy after noticing some inconsistencies in the circular issued for its implementation.
The court was hearing several petitions challenging the BMC’s abrupt halting of its policy to grant permissions for temporary or semi-permanent structures for film shootings.
